name: Fuel Delivery Log
query:
SELECT
  fp.code AS `Delivery Ref`,
  fp.dated AS `Date`,
  fp.supplier AS `Supplier`,
  fp.fuel_type AS `Fuel Type`,
  fp.actual_quantity AS `Quantity`,
  fp.unit_of_measure AS `Unit`,
  fp.unit_cost AS `Unit Cost`,
  fp.total_cost AS `Total Cost`,
  fp.amount_paid AS `Amount Paid`,
  fp.balance AS `Balance`
FROM `tabFuel Purchase` fp
WHERE fp.docstatus < 2
  AND (%(supplier)s IS NULL OR %(supplier)s = '' OR fp.supplier = %(supplier)s)
  AND (%(fuel_type)s IS NULL OR %(fuel_type)s = '' OR fp.fuel_type = %(fuel_type)s)
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR fp.dated >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR fp.dated <= %(to_date)s)
ORDER BY fp.dated DESC
